title: Brent oil tops $109 after Houthi militants claim they attacked Saudi airports and Aramco facilities
summary: Crude oil prices experienced a significant increase on Monday, surpassing $109 per barrel. This rise was attributed to claims made by Iran-backed Houthi militants regarding attacks on key Saudi Arabian airports and Aramco facilities. Additionally, ongoing tensions were exacerbated by Ukraine's strikes on oil installations in Russia, further impacting the global oil market. The geopolitical landscape continues to influence oil prices, highlighting the interconnectedness of regional conflicts and energy supply. Investors remain vigilant as developments unfold in this volatile environment.
